$comment: The `independent` gate question of questions/independence-v2.json (openagents.independence.v2), word for word, under a gym id so the independence-eval-v1 suite can serve it as the candidate wording. The decide step asks it beside `readonly` and `needs_tool_restriction`; the binding reads only this answer, so it is the one measured.
v2 names no count and adds the dependence half of the rule: ordered tasks cannot run at the same time even when their footprints are disjoint.

independence.instructions: The listed tasks can run at the same time without colliding: no two of them edit the same file, and none depends on another finishing first.
